name: pf2-monster-search
description: PF2 Archives of Nethys monster search UI for SQL Server

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-updates.mjs && node scripts/copy-schemas.mjs && node scripts/copy-images.mjs && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.check: node server/scripts/check_raw_md.mjs && node server/scripts/check_api_raw_md.mjs && npm run build
